ruling.recommended_action: Issue a Ryde voucher of $22.99 to the rider for the unexempted detour mileage (approx. 16.3 km of unexempted off-route driving on a metered RydeTAXI trip), and remind the driver that under RD-1 he must take the shortest and most direct route absent a reasonable cause; the claimed East Coast Parkway breakdown does not cover the MCE/Marina Coastal off-route segment that was actually driven.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment from approx. (1.2789,103.8571) to the ECP rejoin near (1.3017,103.9098), where the GPS trace runs through the Marina Coastal/Marina Gardens area (18:37-18:53) instead of the quoted ECP routing (1.27975,103.85942→1.28196,103.86067→…→1.30454,103.92088). Chat is empty (no RD-5 agreement). The only LTA incident (Vehicle breakdown, East Coast Parkway, 18:27) sits ~0.85 km (>300 m matching radius) from the rejoin point, so RD-4(a) corroboration for this segment fails; the only speed band on the route is band 4, which cannot exempt under RD-4(b).

Second off-route deviation near (1.307-1.313,103.908-103.913) at 18:54-18:57, where the trace departs the ECP corridor westwards and doubles back, adding extra distance with no chat agreement (RD-5) and no incident within 300 m of the substituted optimal-route portion (RD-4).

rejected_claims.reason: The ECP vehicle-breakdown incident (reported 18:27) is ~0.85 km from the route's ECP rejoin portion, beyond the 300 m matching radius of RD-4(a), and cannot cover the off-route Marina Coastal segment actually driven; the cited speed band is band 4, which RD-4(b) cannot use to exempt. 'Reasonable cause' therefore fails (RD-4).

The complaint's 'extra distance' is only refundable to the extent it is unexempted detour mileage under RD-2; the map-matching/fare-excess residual beyond the unexempted segments' extra_km is not refundable, and the metered total exceeds the quoted route by only 2.36 km (=24.17-21.811), which I used as the conservative bound.
